name: LOWER
description: LOWER converts all letters in a text string to lowercase, leaving numbers, symbols, and spaces unchanged.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text or cell reference to convert; can be a literal string in quotes or a cell.

basicExample.explanation: All uppercase letters are converted to lowercase.

advancedExamples.title: Normalize an email prefix
advancedExamples.explanation: Mixed-case text is forced to a consistent lowercase form.

advancedExamples.title: Combine with other text
advancedExamples.scenario: Build a lowercase key from a cell
advancedExamples.explanation: LOWER is applied to the combined string so the whole result is lowercase.

howItWorks: LOWER scans each character of the input; uppercase letters are mapped to their lowercase equivalents while every other character (digits, punctuation, spaces) passes through unchanged.

howToSteps.name: Select the text
howToSteps.text: Click the cell with the text to convert.

limitations: Case conversion follows the system's locale rules and may not cover every Unicode casing edge case.
Only affects a single text value; use with arrays or helper columns for ranges.

commonErrors.cause: Passing a non-text argument in strict contexts.
commonErrors.fix: Ensure the argument is text or wrap it with TEXT().

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: LOWER works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does LOWER affect numbers?
faq.answer: No, numbers, spaces, and symbols are left untouched.

faq.question: What is the opposite of LOWER?
faq.answer: UPPER converts to uppercase; PROPER capitalizes each word.

faq.question: Can LOWER handle a range?
faq.answer: In modern Excel it can spill across an array; otherwise apply it per cell or with MAP.
